title: Juicy Charred Malaysian Chicken Satay
description: A flavorful and energizing Malaysian dish featuring charred chicken satay, perfect for a quick and delicious meal, with the warm aroma of cinnamon stick and the freshness of blanched ingredients.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, coriander powder, turmeric powder, low-sodium soy sauce, and brown sugar.
Add the chicken strips to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat, and thread the marinated chicken onto the bamboo skewers.
Brush the grill or grill pan with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the chicken satay for 5-7 minutes per side, or until charred and cooked through.
During the last minute of grilling, add the cinnamon stick to the grill to infuse the satay with its warm aroma.
Once the chicken is cooked, remove the cinnamon stick and serve the satay hot with a side of blanched vegetables and chopped cilantro.
To blanch the vegetables, bring a pot of water to a boil and submerge the vegetables for 30 seconds to 1 minute, then immediately plunge them into an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Serve the chicken satay with the blanched vegetables and enjoy as a delicious and healthy meal.
